items.summary: Reid Hoffman's podcast on scaling companies with frequent B2B-focused episodes including enterprise sales and platform strategy
items.author: MILO Team
items.creator: Reid Hoffman / WaitWhat
items.body:
## Why it is worth subscribing to

While not exclusively B2B, Masters of Scale features many B2B founders sharing their scaling stories. Relevant episodes cover enterprise sales (how Salesforce conquered the enterprise), platform strategy (Slack, Shopify), and building company culture at scale.

## Best for

B2B Product Managers interested in the broader business context of product decisions

## Key takeaway

Reid Hoffman's 'thesis + antithesis' format deconstructs the conventional wisdom about scaling. The B2B episodes provide context for how product decisions interact with sales, marketing, and organisational design.

items.title: The Product Experience (Mind the Product)
items.summary: Weekly product management podcast covering B2B product strategy, discovery, and career growth
items.author: MILO Team
items.creator: Mind the Product
items.body:
## Why it is worth subscribing to

Mind the Product's weekly podcast features interviews with product leaders from around the world. Many episodes address B2B-specific topics: how to manage the tension between customer requests and product strategy, how to communicate with enterprise stakeholders, and how to find product-market fit in B2B.

## Best for

B2B Product Managers looking for a steady stream of product management content

## Key takeaway

The podcast benefits from Mind the Product's large community — guests come from diverse backgrounds and company sizes, providing a broad perspective on B2B product management.

items.title: This is Product Management
items.summary: Podcast by Product Collective covering the full spectrum of product management with many B2B episodes
items.author: MILO Team
items.creator: Product Collective / Alpha
items.body:
## Why it is worth subscribing to

This podcast covers product management topics across industries and company stages. It regularly features B2B product leaders discussing: building B2B products, enterprise customer development, and product-led growth in B2B contexts.

## Best for

B2B Product Managers who want a broad, balanced perspective on product management

## Key takeaway

The 'fake product teardown' episodes are particularly useful — they analyse real B2B product decisions and discuss what worked and what didn't.

items.title: How I Built This (B2B Episodes)
items.summary: Guy Raz's interview series featuring B2B founders sharing their product-building journeys (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Shopify episodes)
items.author: MILO Team
items.creator: Guy Raz / NPR
items.body:
## Why it is worth subscribing to

How I Built This features founders sharing the real stories behind building their companies. Must-listen B2B episodes include: Marc Benioff (Salesforce), Brian Halligan (HubSpot), Stewart Butterfield (Slack), and Tobi Lutke (Shopify). These stories reveal the product decisions that shaped billion-dollar B2B companies.

## Best for

B2B Product Managers seeking inspiration and context around how iconic B2B products were built

## Key takeaway

The most successful B2B products often started as solutions to the founders' own problems. Understanding the origin stories provides perspective on product-market fit, timing, and the importance of listening to early customers.

items.title: B2B Growth Show (by Sweet Fish Media)
items.summary: Daily B2B marketing and growth podcast with episodes on product marketing, sales alignment, and demand generation
items.author: MILO Team
items.creator: Sweet Fish Media
items.body:
## Why it is worth subscribing to

The B2B Growth Show produces daily episodes (10-15 minutes) covering B2B marketing, sales, and product growth. For B2B PMs, episodes on product marketing alignment, demand generation strategies, and account-based marketing provide valuable context for product decisions.

## Best for

B2B Product Managers who want to understand the marketing and sales side of the business

## Key takeaway

The daily format means topics are current and relevant. The focus on actionable tactics rather than high-level theory makes it easy to apply insights immediately.

items.title: Product Stories Podcast
items.summary: Podcast interviewing product leaders about real product decisions with strong B2B representation
items.author: MILO Team
items.creator: Product Stories
items.body:
## Why it is worth subscribing to

Product Stories features in-depth interviews with product leaders about specific product decisions: what they considered, how they decided, and what happened. Many guests are from B2B companies (Intercom, Canva, Atlassian, Zapier) and share candid lessons.

## Best for

B2B Product Managers who learn best from real-world case studies

## Key takeaway

The show's strength is the depth of each episode — guests walk through a single product decision in detail, showing the trade-offs and thought process rather than just the outcome.

items.title: B2B Product Camp (Virtual)
items.summary: Free virtual unconference for B2B product managers. Community-run sessions on pricing experiments, enterprise discovery, and stakeholder alignment.

items.title: PLG Europe Conference
items.summary: European conference focused on product-led growth in B2B SaaS. Sessions on freemium strategy, trial conversion optimization, and PLG metrics benchmarks.

items.title: Product-Led Summit Europe
items.summary: European edition of the Product-Led Summit. Covers B2B PLG strategies, local market considerations, and GDPR-compliant growth tactics.

items.title: April Dunford — Positioning for Enterprise Markets
items.summary: Positioning expert April Dunford on how to position B2B products for enterprise buyers. Covers market context, alternative-based positioning, and value wedges.
items.author: April Dunford

items.title: Intercom — Conversational Support in Enterprise SaaS
items.summary: How Intercom built conversational support for enterprise customers. Covers multi-channel support, AI assistants, and self-serve deflection in B2B settings.
items.author: Intercom

items.title: B2B Product Pricing: Packaging for Enterprise Growth
items.summary: Deep dive on B2B pricing packaging strategy. Covers tier design, feature gating, usage-based vs per-seat tradeoffs, and how to avoid cannibalizing revenue.
items.author: Patrick Campbell / ProfitWell

items.title: The B2B Product Discovery Gap
items.summary: Why traditional discovery methods fail in B2B and how to adapt. Covers multi-stakeholder validation, proxy user research, and low-N interviewing techniques.
items.author: Teresa Torres

items.title: Enterprise Product Adoption Metrics that Actually Predict Retention
items.summary: Beyond DAU/MAU: the metrics that matter for B2B products. Covers team activation rates, feature adoption by department, and time-to-value benchmarks.
items.author: Amplitude Blog

items.title: Building a Product Intelligence Stack for B2B SaaS
items.summary: How to build a product intelligence stack for B2B. Covers tool selection, event taxonomy, data warehousing, and building a single customer view across accounts.
items.author: Twilio Segment

items.title: B2B Product-Led Onboarding Certification (Pendo)
items.summary: Free certification covering B2B onboarding best practices. Covers user segmentation, in-app guidance design, adoption analytics, and NPS survey implementation.
items.author: Pendo

items.title: Enterprise API Product Management Course (Postman)
items.summary: Free course on managing APIs as products. Covers API-first design, developer portal management, API versioning, and developer metrics for platform teams.
items.author: Postman

items.title: B2B Continuous Discovery Workshop (Product Talk)
items.summary: Hands-on workshop on running continuous discovery in B2B contexts. Covers adapting opportunity solution trees for enterprise, stakeholder management, and discovery cadence.
items.author: Teresa Torres / Product Talk
